metadata.question: Was there an active fire present near Paradise, California between November 7, 2018 to November 10, 2018?

data.raw_code: The question is about detecting active fires near Paradise, California during a specific time period (Nov 7-10, 2018). This requires: 1. **Search Strategy**: Use active fire detection data. MODIS/VIIRS active fire products would be appropriate. 2. **Location**: Paradise, CA coordinates (39.7596° N, 121.6219° W) with a buffer to search nearby areas. 3. **Date Range**: November 7-10, 2018. 4. **Data Source**: VIIRS Active Fire data (VNP14IMGML) would be good for this time period and provides good spatial resolution. 5. **Logic**: Count fire pixels with confidence levels indicating active fires. I'll use: - Collection: 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML' - Geometry: Point near Paradise, CA with buffer - Filter by date and confidence level - Count fire pixels to determine presence For validation: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if any valid fire pixels found after filtering (C2) - Valid result would be A (yes) if fire pixels > 0, B (no) if 0 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const paradise = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.6219, 39.7596]); const searchArea = paradise.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Paradise const startDate = '2018-11-07'; const endDate = '2018-11-10'; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Active Fire data let fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(searchArea); // Check if collection is empty const collectionSize = await fireCollection.size().getInfo(); if (collectionSize === 0) { print("No VIIRS fire data found for the date range."); print("C1"); return; } print(`VIIRS images found: ${collectionSize}`); // 3. Processing - Filter for high confidence fires and count pixels // Confidence values: 0=not processed, 1-4=low, 5-8=nominal, 9=high const highConfidenceFires = fireCollection.filter(ee.Filter.gte('Confidence', 7)); // Count fire pixels in the region const fireCountImage = highConfidenceFires.select('Confidence').reduce(ee.Reducer.count()); const fireStats = await fireCountImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: searchArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const totalFirePixels = fireStats.Confidence || 0; print(`High confidence fire pixels: ${totalFirePixels}`); print(`Search area radius: 10km around Paradise, CA`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (totalFirePixels === 0) { print("B"); } else if (totalFirePixels > 0) { print("A"); } else { print("C3"); } } catch (error) { print(`Error: ${error}`); print("D"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
